skills.name: Composite - Spray liquid from a spray bottle or hose
skills.description: Spray liquid from a spray bottle or hose onto a surface or object

steps.activity: Determine the position on the spray_target where the liquid_to_spray will be sprayed
Position the spray_tool toward the spray_target
Press the trigger of the spray_tool to spray the liquid_to_spray

examples: Spray water on a wall with a spray bottle
